status: Local protocol written before fitting phase-15 models; not an external preregistration
question: Can shared short edge rewrites connect pharmaceutical labels to their own leaf prose after holding that whole leaf out of fitting?
physical_unit: The folio number f88, f89, f99, f100, f101, f102; all recto/verso/foldout panels of a folio stay together. Include all pharmaceutical prose, including f101r.
prior_exposure: These leaves were used or viewed in phase 14. Held out here means excluded from model fitting within this phase, not historically unseen by the analyst.

conditions.strict: Primary: one clean alphabetical label of >=3 EVA letters, conservative unambiguous prose words. Exclude uncertain symbols, spaces and ligatures.
conditions.lattice: Sensitivity: retain explicit bracket alternatives, ordinary ligature letter contents, comma split/join alternatives; whole labels may have <=2 words and prose matches may concatenate <=2 adjacent words. Never cross lines or drawing interruptions. No unknown-sign wildcard. Bound any local alternative set to <=16. This is a bounded segmentation search, not phonetic decipherment.

units: cth, ckh, cph, cfh, ch, sh treated as indivisible EVA units; remaining letters individual. These are not claimed phonemes.
rule_family: Identity, or one left-edge or right-edge rewrite replacing 0..2 units with 0..2 units. Unchanged stem >=3 units. No simultaneous edits at both ends, internal substitutions or per-word rules.
fit: Leave one of six physical folios out. Identity always present. Greedily add at most three rewrites. Each candidate must match >=3 distinct training label spellings across >=2 training folios under current assigned label/prose correspondence. Maximize mean-per-folio own-prose hit fraction minus other-training-prose hit fraction. Require improvement >0.01 per added rule. Deterministic lexical tie break. Model selection has no access to the held-out leaf's labels or prose.
primary_statistic: Cross-fitted mean-per-leaf own-prose fraction minus mean fraction in the other five folios, using the union of identity and selected rules. Also record the improvement relative to identity.
null: Enumerate all 6! =720 assignments of whole prose folios to label folios. Refit each model under each assignment, including held-out training exclusion. Exact upper-tail p = fraction of all assignments whose statistic >= identity assignment statistic. No Monte Carlo correction when identity is in the full enumeration.
sensitivity: Restrict permutation results to assignments preserving number of physical panels with prose (4! x 2! =48 expected). ZL/IT are sensitivity checks on the same manuscript, not independent replications. Report no-training-spelling subset descriptively, no separate significance claim.
controls: Constructed positive corpus with shared q-prefix link on unique generated label strings; constructed disconnected prose negative control. Confirm learned transform and held-out behavior. Independently verify matched forms against explicit outputs.
interpretation: A positive signal establishes only this structural relation under this null. Neither grammatical function, language, meaning, nor translation follows. A negative result rules out no other decipherment family.
